summary: Add portable SSH-signed gate observations in immutable git notes refs

replay.detail: No change to existing daemon state or workflows.

schema.detail: Adds a v1 portable Git notes record format and repository evidence policy file. Full/test tiers use SSH-signed notes commits; degraded records are explicitly unsigned. No daemon database DDL, replay, or checkpoint change.

rules.detail: No change to existing daemon state or workflows.

compatibility.detail: New offline st evidence put, show and verify commands and a v1 in-toto statement in SSH-signed Git notes commits. No client protocol or existing command changes. Gate enforcement and signer adapters are not activated. Records report full, degraded, or test trust; daemon policy permits only full. Re-attestation requires a separate full-trust rerun record. Stage policy is loaded from the accepted base commit, so a target cannot lower its own requirements. Schema version and opaque test inputs reserve affected-set extensions.

downtime.detail: No change to existing daemon state or workflows.

manual.detail: Users opting into evidence supply an external SSH allowed-signers file and fetch/push refs/notes/evidence/*. The repository policy names roles but grants no signing-key trust. Production observers require protected key provisioning.

recovery.detail: Evidence verification refuses missing, forged or inapplicable records. Immutable record refs can be fetched from a peer; replacing a record ref is rejected. Existing queue and review workflows remain unchanged.
